newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources extends Kansas offer.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources extends Kansas offer.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said on Wednesday it had extended the expiration date of its tender offer for Kansas City Power and Light Co to February 5 from January 15.
"Western Resources ...will continue to refrain from actively soliciting tenders of KCPL shares ...as a result of the positive dialogue between the two companies," it said.
The company said 30.2 million shares of KCPL or 49 percent of all of those oustanding had been tendered as of January 15.
It had extended the expiration date to January 15 last December for the same reasons.
In June, Western Resources increased its offer to $31 from $28 in its stock for each share of Kansas City Power stock.
The deal is valued at $1.9 billion.
